sources.title: Brainwashing Versus Free Choice: Responsibility for Criminal Acts by Cult Members
supports: Janja Lalich's bounded-choice framework uses four interlocking features: charismatic authority, transcendent belief system, systems of control and systems of influence
framework is an analytical model for high-control/self-sealing groups, not a universal legal definition

sources.title: Methodology: How hate groups are identified and categorized
supports: SPLC defines and classifies hate groups using its own stated methodology
SPLC distinguishes organizations from individuals
historical methodology relied on publications, citizen reports, law enforcement, field sources, web postings and news reports
classification should be modeled as classifier -> classification event -> entity, not intrinsic universal truth

sources.title: ADL H.E.A.T. Map

data sources include news/media, government documents, victim reports, extremist-related sources and ADL investigations
incident mapping is analytically distinct from assigning an organization-level label

sources.title: Meet Unit 8200
supports: Unit 8200 is the central collection unit of Israel's Military Intelligence Directorate
the unit develops and operates collection, analysis, processing and dissemination systems and works across cyber and signals-intelligence functions
the IDF itself states that many alumni occupy important positions in the Israeli economy and public sphere

sources.title: What is Israel's secretive cyber warfare unit 8200?
supports: Unit 8200 is a major Israeli military intelligence and cyber unit frequently compared with NSA/GCHQ
Reuters documents a substantial alumni pipeline from Unit 8200 into Israel's technology sector
alumni movement into private technology does not by itself prove continued state direction of alumni companies

sources.title: How a Private Israeli Intelligence Firm Spied on Pro-Palestinian Activists in the U.S.
supports: Psy-Group was an Israeli private-intelligence/influence firm that recruited from intelligence backgrounds
the firm used false identities or avatars as part of covert influence work
the company discussed proposed 2016 U.S. election influence work with Trump-campaign-linked actors but its CEO said those talks did not result in work for the campaign
Psy-Group had ceased operations by the time of the report

sources.title: Israel ducks blame for firm with ex-intel officers that bid to 'shape' US vote
supports: a U.S. Senate committee examined Psy-Group among foreign-linked influence companies in relation to the 2016 election
the committee examined whether techniques honed in foreign intelligence services could migrate into private influence work
the reporting does not establish that Psy-Group changed the outcome of the 2016 election

sources.title: About Us
supports: Israel365 Action says it was launched after October 7, 2023

its declared mission includes mobilizing Jews and Christians, defending Judeo-Christian Western civilization, advocating Israeli control over Judea and Samaria, and countering narratives it describes as misinformation
its stated strategy includes leadership events, conferences, educational trips, webinars, rallies, action alerts and advocacy resources

sources.title: World Zionist Congress
supports: Israel365 Action says it won two seats in the 2025 World Zionist Congress election
it states that its WZC priorities include Israeli sovereignty in Judea and Samaria, information-war advocacy and Judeo-Christian political values
these are overt political-religious goals rather than evidence of covert control

ADL's ideological labels and account-affiliation judgments remain attributed classifier findings rather than legal status
